notes: SHIP v1.14.393 - COMMAND HERO GETS THE SAME EVENT-DRIVEN RECOVERY. The rack now loads in the Build workspace on device, confirmed by the owner on v1.14.392. This closes the other half of the identical defect. The physical iPhone logged "hero mount not laid out after 600f - will retry on next render" from cmd_rackHero3D at dct-ios.html:21777 - the COMMAND page hero at #cc-rackhero-mount, a different surface from the Build mount that was repaired in .392. That message was the literal defect: a next cmd_render is not guaranteed, so with no state mutation the hero stayed on its loading text permanently. The 600-frame rAF budget is now a fast path only; when it is spent the code hands off to a ResizeObserver that fires the moment the mount becomes measurable, whatever finally gives it size, and re-arms a fresh paint. The observer disconnects on leaving Command or on detach, so nothing is left spinning. A terminal error is reported only when ResizeObserver itself is unavailable. Kept deliberately separate from .392 because it is a different surface, and bundling it would have repeated the exact mistake .392 documents - the captured log was read as Build evidence when it came from the hero. FLAT is still reserved for genuine WebGL unavailability per the owner ruling; a mount that will not lay out is a layout anomaly and is never masked with the flat list. SCENE UNTOUCHED - lighting, materials, geometry, fog, camera direction, floor, reflection, tone mapping, tray geometry and TYPE_COLORS are exactly as they were. STILL OPEN AND DISCLOSED: the bottom nav fourth item is EXIT where the approved reference shows SHIFT; the rack control rail wraps 4-then-1 and carries REAR and EXPLODE which the reference does not show; and the metrics layout has still not been visually verified against a Master-linked rack. DEVICE-VERIFY: cold load to Command with a Master loaded and confirm the RACK HERO draws without touching anything; then open Build and confirm that rack still draws; then return to Command.
